Needs a master's degree, or the four-year degree route set out in the bulletin. The December 2026 cycle was reported open with exams in late December. The JRF age limit is reported as 30. A CSIR JRF is paid ₹37,000 a month.
Not with a plain three-year BSc. Read the current NTA bulletin for the exact marks and age rule.

An MSc in physics with Physics and Mathematics at BSc level, at least 60% aggregate in the MSc and 60% in BSc physics, or a BE/BTech in Engineering Physics. Screening is by the BARC online test or a valid step Physics score from 2024, 2025 or 2026. The notice says final selection is solely on interview performance. Age limit 26 for the general category on 1 August 2026. MSc Medical Physics, Chemical Physics and Geophysics are named as not eligible for this discipline.
No. It needs the MSc. A BSc graduate should plan the MSc with maths and 60% in mind.
